area: Builders: the admin rank of the rules AI Guard routing, the ZIA security baseline, the SSL certificate move, a policy pack deploy and a Bulk changes reorder create or move (rank_inherit.py)
title: New and moved rules take the admin rank they need with Admin Ranking on, never one the API client cannot assign; preview, read-back and Undo cover the rank

checks.what: Oracle: a new rule at order N takes the rank of the rule now at N (on), of the rule just above it when last, rank 7 when the policy is empty, off, unknown or not read
The API client's own rank is inferred from the rules' accessControl (the SDK 1.11.3 has no call for it), marked assumed; rank 7 is always assignable
Admin Ranking is read once through zia.advanced_settings only with ZIA platform ticked; a refusal, a missing or non-boolean field is unknown, never off; the tenant's words are not echoed

AI Guard: QUIC block, SSL Inspect at the top, forwarding, Cloud App Control and URL allows take the needed rank on, 7 off or unknown; its own rule moved to the top is re-ranked and Undo puts rank and order back
Rank too low: AI Guard's order-1 SSL Inspect rule below rank 0-4 rules the client cannot edit gets rank 7 at order 3 and the preview says it will not be first; the typed confirmation still applies
ZIA baseline rules added last take the rank of the rule just above them (on), 7 otherwise; without ZIA platform the setting is not read
SSL certificate move keeps rank and order, says so, and the read-back fails a rule ZIA stored at another rank

Pack deploy: the Web DLP rule at order 1 takes the rank it needs (on), the pack's 7 otherwise; Use rank 0 still wins; the plan hash binds the ranks (a re-ranked top rule stops the deploy); read-back and verification report another stored rank

Reorder: a rule moved above rank-0 rules takes rank 0 (on), keeps its rank when it fits, ranks untouched off or unknown; Undo restores order and rank; a dropped rank is reported; Undo ranks validated 0-7 with rule ids
The deploy request's scopes are filtered to Scope page keys before the plan reads anything
The Bulk changes rank table is captioned with column headers and every value escaped; the deploy plan's rank and read-back lines are escaped

findings.title: Every builder and pack wrote rank 7 whatever the tenant's Admin Ranking: with it on, a rule asked for at order 1 (AI Guard's SSL Inspect, forwarding and allow rules, pack rules) was evaluated after every rule of rank 0-6, so it was not first and the preview did not say so
findings.fix: rank_inherit.place: the rank of the rule placed above (or just above, going last), never one the client cannot assign; used by ops_aiguard, ops_zia_baseline and pack_deploy; the preview lists each rule's rank and why

findings.title: When the API role's admin rank was too low for the rank a rule needed, nothing warned that the rule would land below higher-rank rules
findings.fix: rank_inherit.caller infers the client's rank from accessControl (assumed, said); a rank above it is replaced by one it may assign, the order sent is where ZIA will keep it, and the preview warns it is not first

findings.title: Read-back did not check the rank ZIA stored (AI Guard, baseline creates, certificate moves, reorders, pack deploys), so a rank ZIA changed or dropped went unreported
findings.fix: rank_inherit.stored compares the stored rank (and order where nothing else moves it) with what was sent; each builder's verify and the pack read-back report both values

findings.title: A Bulk changes reorder moved a rule without the rank its new place needs (with Admin Ranking on ZIA keeps it with its own rank), and its Undo could not put a rank back
findings.fix: admin_ops._plan_reorder: rank_inherit.place_moves plans the rank change with the move (send_rank, conflict guard on the rank); inverse carries ranks; rule_rank handler for a rank-only Undo step

findings.title: Review & remediate fix recipes (remediation.py) still create a rule with the order and rank typed in their form (rank 7 by default), not the inherited rank
findings.reason: The operator types the rule's order and admin rank in that form (with a hint), so the rank is the operator's explicit choice; the builders and packs that choose a place themselves now pick the rank too.
